Hobbies That Are Good for You
When work or school is over, what do you do to pass the time?
lines.zh: 工作或学习结束后，你做什么来打发时间？

lines.t: Do you spend time on your hobbies?
lines.zh: 你会在爱好上花时间吗？

lines.t: Reading or listening to music can help us to calm down after a busy day.
lines.zh: 阅读或听音乐能帮助我们在忙碌一天后平静下来。

lines.t: Physical hobbies, such as playing tennis or doing yoga, can help us to keep fit.
lines.zh: 打网球或练瑜伽这样的运动爱好能帮助我们保持健康。

lines.t: And some hobbies are creative.
For example, people sometimes paint pictures to remember a beautiful landscape or object, or reduce stress.
lines.zh: 例如，人们有时画画是为了记住美丽的风景或物品，或者减轻压力。

lines.t: Luca Bruno likes to be creative in his free time.
lines.zh: 卢卡·布鲁诺喜欢在空闲时间搞创作。

lines.t: But he doesn't make art or write stories.
lines.zh: 但他不搞艺术，也不写故事。

lines.t: Instead, this Italian teenager finds it fun to make mobile phone apps.
lines.zh: 相反，这个意大利少年觉得开发手机应用程序很有趣。

lines.t: He thinks that apps can be a great way to help people.
lines.zh: 他认为应用程序是帮助人们的好方法。

lines.t: He started programming when he was ten, after he read about famous businessmen who started out as programmers.
lines.zh: 他十岁开始编程，那时他读到了一些以程序员起家的著名商人的故事。

lines.t: His latest app allows people around the world to find study partners for learning Italian.
lines.zh: 他最新的应用程序让世界各地的人都能找到学意大利语的学习伙伴。

lines.t: They can learn Italian and make friends at the same time!
lines.zh: 他们可以一边学意大利语一边交朋友！

lines.t: "It gives me such a sense of achievement to see people using the app,"
lines.zh: “看到人们用这个应用程序，我很有成就感。”

lines.t: says Luca.
"I believe I'm helping people around the world to learn Italian!"
lines.zh: “我相信我在帮助世界各地的人学习意大利语！”

lines.t: Some people prefer not to make things.

lines.t: Instead, this teenage girl collects postcards!
lines.zh: 相反，这个十几岁的女孩收集明信片！

lines.t: "I know some people think postcards are rather old-fashioned, but I think they're a good way to learn about different places,"

lines.t: She dreams of travelling to these places in the future!

lines.t: A Cooking Accident
James lived in the city with his friend Allen.
lines.zh: 詹姆斯和他的朋友艾伦住在城里。

lines.t: It was their first time living away from their families, and they enjoyed learning how to do many things themselves.
lines.zh: 这是他们第一次离开家人生活，他们很喜欢学着自己做很多事。

lines.t: One Saturday, James decided to make fried chicken.
lines.zh: 一个星期六，詹姆斯决定做炸鸡。

lines.t: First, he poured oil into a pan.
Then he turned on the stove and left the oil to heat while he prepared the chicken.
lines.zh: 然后他打开炉子，把油放在上面加热，自己去准备鸡肉。

lines.t: Just then, he heard the front door open, followed by the sound of Allen singing.
lines.zh: 就在这时，他听到前门开了，接着是艾伦唱歌的声音。

lines.t: "Guess what," Allen
called out happily.
"We won!"
"No way!"

lines.zh: 詹姆斯跟着他走进了客厅。

lines.t: He wanted to hear all about the football game!
lines.zh: 他想听听足球比赛的全部经过！

lines.t: Suddenly, Allen stopped talking and looked up.
lines.zh: 突然，艾伦停止说话，抬起头来。

lines.t: "Hey, do you smell something burning?"
lines.zh: “嘿，你闻到什么东西烧焦了吗？”

lines.t: "Oh no!"

The pan was on fire!
Large flames were jumping into the air.
In a panic, James turned off the stove at once. But he was so close to the pan that a flame jumped onto his shirt.
lines.zh: 惊慌之中，詹姆斯立刻关掉了炉子。但他离锅太近了，一团火苗蹿到了他的衬衫上。

lines.t: James cried out and threw himself to the floor.
lines.zh: 詹姆斯叫了一声，扑倒在地上。

lines.t: What mistake did Matt make at the basketball game?

lines.t: You Can't Win Them All
When the bell rang, Matt entered the classroom with a heavy heart.
lines.zh: 铃响时，马特心情沉重地走进了教室。

lines.t: "Hey, Matt,"
his best friend Tom greeted him.
lines.zh: 他最好的朋友汤姆跟他打招呼。

lines.t: He and Tom were in the school's basketball team.
lines.zh: 他和汤姆都是校篮球队的。

lines.t: "Why the long face?
Are you still feeling blue about Saturday night's game?"
lines.zh: 你还在为星期六晚上的比赛闷闷不乐吗？”

lines.t: Tom asked.
"Of course I am,"
Matt said quietly.
He didn't dare to look at Tom as he spoke.
"I'm really sorry about letting everybody down.
The other team got those points because of me."
lines.zh: 对方得那几分都是因为我。”

lines.t: "Don't be too hard on yourself!" Tom said.
"Although you pushed their player, it was just an accident.
lines.zh: “虽然你推了他们的队员，但那只是个意外。

lines.t: Everyone knows that!"
Tom was a good friend. But Matt knew the referee didn't share Tom's opinion.
lines.zh: 汤姆是个好朋友。但马特知道裁判并不同意汤姆的看法。

lines.t: When the referee saw Matt push another player, he gave the other team two free throws.
lines.zh: 裁判看到马特推了对方队员，就判给对方两次罚球。

lines.t: Matt was as shocked as anyone else when the accident happened, but it was too late.
lines.zh: 意外发生时，马特和其他人一样震惊，但已经太晚了。

lines.t: He couldn't take it back.
"I guess we have to respect his decision,"
Matt said after a while.
"But we had a good chance to win until I made that mistake.
lines.zh: “可是在我犯那个错之前，我们很有机会赢。

lines.t: Why wasn't I more careful?"
lines.zh: 我为什么不更小心一点呢？”

lines.t: "Listen, Matt," said Tom,
"try to look on the bright side.

lines.zh: 对方是我们地区最好的球队，但我们的比分非常接近。

lines.t: I'm proud of us, and I know our coach and everyone else in our school are as well."
lines.zh: 我为我们感到骄傲，我知道我们的教练和全校的人也一样。”

lines.t: Matt felt a bit better.

I guess it's just hard to lose."
lines.zh: 我想只是输了比赛很难受。”

lines.t: "Hey, you can't win them all," said Tom.
lines.zh: “嘿，你不可能每次都赢。”汤姆说。

lines.t: "It's more important to learn from your mistakes so that you don't repeat them in future.
lines.zh: “更重要的是从错误中学习，以后不再重犯。

lines.t: We'll keep working together as a team. One for all, and all for one, right?"
lines.zh: 我们会继续团结一致。人人为我，我为人人，对吧？”

lines.t: "You're right.
If we pull together, we should win next time,"
lines.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，下次就该赢了。”

lines.t: Matt smiled.
He was lucky to have a friend like Tom!

lines.t: Reaching New Heights
To most people, Mount Qomolangma is one of the greatest wonders of the world.
lines.zh: 对大多数人来说，珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最伟大的奇观之一。

lines.t: On the highest place on earth, you will feel like you are able to touch the sky.
lines.zh: 站在地球的最高处，你会觉得自己能摸到天空。

lines.t: But only the best climbers reach the top, and that is only if they survive the terrible conditions first.
lines.zh: 但只有最优秀的登山者才能登顶，而且前提是他们先要熬过恶劣的环境。

lines.t: On the mountain, temperatures can fall to –30 degrees.
lines.zh: 山上的气温可能降到零下30度。

lines.t: Climbers must also deal with thin air, high cliffs, and changeable weather.
lines.zh: 登山者还必须应对稀薄的空气、高耸的悬崖和多变的天气。

lines.t: Before 1960, no one was able to reach the top of Qomolangma from the northern side.
lines.zh: 1960年以前，没有人能从北坡登上珠穆朗玛峰顶。

lines.t: Mountain climbers even called that way the "Death Road", but a Chinese climbing team was determined to make the climb.
lines.zh: 登山者甚至把那条路称为“死亡之路”，但一支中国登山队决心攀登。

lines.t: On the 24th of May 1960, climbers Liu Lianman, Wang Fuzhou, Qu Yinhua and Gombu arrived at the second step.
lines.zh: 1960年5月24日，登山队员刘连满、王富洲、屈银华和贡布到达了第二台阶。

lines.t: It was 8,600 metres above sea level.
People said it was so high that even birds could not reach it.
lines.zh: 人们说那里高得连鸟都飞不上去。

lines.t: Bit by bit, the climbers pulled themselves up, and they made it past the Second Step.

lines.t: At 4:20 a.m. on 25 May, the Chinese national flag flew above the world's highest mountain for the first time.
lines.zh: 5月25日凌晨4点20分，中国国旗第一次飘扬在世界最高峰之上。

lines.t: In 1975, another Chinese team climbed to the top of Qomolangma to do research.
lines.zh: 1975年，另一支中国登山队登上珠穆朗玛峰顶进行科学考察。

lines.t: This time, they brought a ladder to the Second Step.
lines.zh: 这一次，他们把一架梯子带到了第二台阶。

lines.t: Until 2007, almost all climbers from the northern side used this "Chinese Ladder" to reach the top much faster.
lines.zh: 直到2007年，几乎所有从北坡攀登的登山者都借助这架“中国梯”更快地登顶。

lines.t: Some climbers reach the top successfully, but many fail.

lines.t: Why do people still risk their lives to climb the highest mountain in the world?

lines.t: It is because human curiosity and ambition cannot be stopped.

lines.t: How One Girl Saved Many Lives
lines.zh: 一个女孩怎样救了许多人

lines.t: On 26 December 2004, Tilly Smith, a 10-year-old English schoolgirl, and her family were on holiday in Phuket, Thailand.
lines.zh: 2004年12月26日，10岁的英国女学生蒂莉·史密斯和家人在泰国普吉岛度假。

lines.t: Everyone was enjoying the beautiful weather that morning.
lines.zh: 那天早上，每个人都在享受美好的天气。

lines.t: Some people were swimming in the sea, and some were relaxing on the beach.
lines.zh: 有些人在海里游泳，有些人在沙滩上放松。

lines.t: But while Tilly was walking along the beach with her family, she noticed something strange.
lines.zh: 但蒂莉和家人沿着海滩散步时，她注意到了一些奇怪的事。

lines.t: Thick white froth was forming on top of the waves.
lines.zh: 厚厚的白色泡沫正在浪尖上形成。

lines.t: Next, she saw that the waves were coming in instead of going out.
lines.zh: 接着，她看到海浪在往岸上涌，而不是往外退。

lines.t: Just then, she remembered something important.
lines.zh: 就在那时，她想起了一件重要的事。

lines.t: Two weeks before, her geography teacher had explained that earthquakes under the sea could create dangerous waves called tsunamis!
lines.zh: 两周前，她的地理老师讲过，海底地震会引发叫作海啸的危险巨浪！

lines.t: "I know what's going to happen!
There's going to be a big wave,"
Tilly cried.
Unfortunately, her family didn't believe her and wanted to continue their walk.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，她的家人不相信她，还想继续散步。

lines.t: However, Tilly refused to take a single step further.
lines.zh: 然而，蒂莉拒绝再往前走一步。

lines.t: Finally, her mother decided to continue the walk alone, and the rest of her family returned to the hotel.
lines.zh: 最后，她妈妈决定一个人继续散步，其余家人回到了酒店。

lines.t: Back at the hotel, Tilly's father told a security guard about the tsunami.
lines.zh: 回到酒店，蒂莉的爸爸把海啸的事告诉了一名保安。

lines.t: The security guard was shocked.
He knew about the huge earthquake in nearby Indonesia.
lines.zh: 他知道附近的印度尼西亚发生了大地震。

lines.t: It meant that a tsunami was possible!
lines.zh: 这意味着可能会有海啸！

lines.t: He jumped into action right away and rushed to get people off the beach.
lines.zh: 他立刻行动起来，赶紧让人们离开海滩。

lines.t: Everyone began to panic.
People were screaming and running as fast as they could when they saw a huge wall of water coming from the sea.
lines.zh: 当人们看到一堵巨大的水墙从海上涌来时，他们尖叫着拼命奔跑。

lines.t: Tilly was right!
Her mother was one of the last people on the beach, but thankfully, her family made it to safety just as the water hit the hotel.
lines.zh: 她妈妈是最后离开海滩的人之一，但谢天谢地，就在海水冲到酒店时，她一家都到了安全的地方。

lines.t: The 2004 tsunami caused over 200,000 deaths, but no one on the beach died that day.
lines.zh: 2004年的海啸造成了二十多万人死亡，但那天那片海滩上没有一个人遇难。

lines.t: This true story shows how a single lesson could mean the difference between life and death.
lines.zh: 这个真实的故事说明，一堂课可能决定生死。

lines.t: Thanks to her knowledge and quick thinking, one schoolgirl was able to save over 100 lives.
lines.zh: 凭借她的知识和敏捷的思维，一个女学生救了一百多人的性命。

lines.t: Sure!

lines.zh: 首先，他们有一种特别的问候方式。

lines.t: They press their palms together, bow, and say, "Namaste."

lines.t: Wow! I'll remember that.

lines.t: With my knife and fork?

lines.t: Very often they eat with their hands instead.
OK! Anything else?
Yes! People in India often eat a lot of curry.

lines.t: I ate chicken curry there, and it was delicious!
lines.zh: 我在那里吃了咖喱鸡，非常好吃！

lines.t: But don't expect to eat any beef.
Cows are protected in India.
They are special to many people.
lines.zh: 对许多人来说，牛很特别。

lines.t: And they even walk anywhere they like!

lines.t: While we were there, one walked right in front of our car!

lines.zh: 我今晚在朋友家吃晚饭。但英国的餐桌礼仪太令人困惑了，我有点担心。

Ask me anything!
Thanks!

lines.zh: 嗯，首先，我应该带点东西去吗？

lines.t: Yes. Bring a small gift, but don't bring food unless the host asks you to. And remember to wait for the host to start before you eat.
lines.zh: 是的。带一件小礼物，但除非主人请你带，否则不要带食物。还要记得等主人开始吃了你再吃。

lines.t: Good to know!

lines.zh: 你能告诉我使用刀叉的正确方法吗？

lines.t: Just hold the knife in your right hand, and the fork in your left.
lines.zh: 只要右手拿刀，左手拿叉就行了。

lines.t: If you get confused, watch what everyone else does.
lines.zh: 如果你感到困惑，就看看别人是怎么做的。

lines.t: OK.

lines.zh: 一开始我有点孤独，但我开始交到一些朋友了。

lines.t: They helped me to learn more about the customs here after I had some embarrassing experiences at a party last month.
lines.zh: 上个月我在一次聚会上有过一些尴尬的经历之后，他们帮我更多地了解了这里的习俗。

lines.t: I'd like to share some tips with you.
lines.zh: 我想和你分享一些建议。

lines.t: First, you shouldn't arrive early to a party.
lines.zh: 首先，你参加聚会不应该早到。

lines.t: It's normal to be on time or a few minutes late, but arriving early can cause problems.
lines.zh: 准时或晚几分钟到是正常的，但早到可能会带来麻烦。

lines.t: Once, I arrived 10 minutes early to a party.
lines.zh: 有一次，我提前10分钟到了一个聚会。

lines.t: Usually that's the polite thing to do, right?

lines.t: But my friend looked so surprised to see me!

lines.t: He was still getting everything ready.

lines.zh: 其次，拜访别人时带礼物很重要。

lines.t: When I attended my friend's party, I didn't bring anything.
lines.zh: 我参加朋友的聚会时，什么也没带。

lines.t: It wasn't his birthday, but everyone else brought gifts like chocolates or flowers to thank him for the party.
lines.zh: 那天不是他的生日，但其他人都带了巧克力或花之类的礼物来感谢他办聚会。

lines.t: I was so embarrassed!
Third, you should always try to dress for the occasion.
lines.zh: 第三，你应该总是根据场合穿着。

lines.t: At that party it was surprising to see how nicely everyone was dressed.
lines.zh: 在那次聚会上，看到每个人都穿得那么讲究，我很吃惊。

lines.t: It was summer, so I was just wearing a simple blouse and shorts.
lines.zh: 那时是夏天，所以我只穿了一件简单的女式衬衫和短裤。

lines.t: But everyone else was dressed so well that I felt silly.
lines.zh: 但其他人都穿得那么好，我觉得自己很傻。

lines.t: Fourth, it's best not to ask personal questions unless you know the person well.
lines.zh: 第四，除非和对方很熟，最好不要问私人问题。

lines.t: Many French people are quite private.
lines.zh: 许多法国人相当注重隐私。

lines.t: They don't like it when others ask them about their age, their family, whether they are married, or how much money they make.
lines.zh: 他们不喜欢别人问他们的年龄、家庭、是否结婚或挣多少钱。

lines.t: Food and culture, however, are safe conversation topics.
lines.zh: 不过，食物和文化是安全的聊天话题。

lines.t: Last but not least, make sure you use French whenever you can.
lines.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，尽量多说法语。

lines.t: Lots of people speak English here, but you can develop closer relationships with them if you use French.
lines.zh: 这里很多人会说英语，但如果你用法语，就能和他们建立更亲密的关系。

lines.t: It's very important in their culture.
lines.zh: 这在他们的文化中非常重要。

lines.t: I found that even a simple "merci" goes a long way!

lines.t: You'll see what I mean as soon as you get here!

The Secret Garden
A summary of Frances Hodgson Burnett's The Secret Garden)
lines.zh: （弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特《秘密花园》概要）

lines.t: In this story, Mary Lennox, a spoiled and selfish 10-year-old girl goes to live with her uncle, Mr Craven, after her parents pass away.
lines.zh: 在这个故事里，被宠坏的自私的10岁女孩玛丽·伦诺克斯在父母去世后，去和她的姑父克雷文先生一起生活。

lines.t: Her uncle has a huge house, but he is seldom there.
lines.zh: 她的姑父有一座大房子，但他很少在家。

lines.t: Mary spends a lot of time alone and gets bored.
lines.zh: 玛丽很多时间都是一个人，觉得很无聊。

lines.t: At night she often hears crying coming from somewhere.
lines.zh: 晚上她常常听到不知哪里传来的哭声。

lines.t: One day, Mary hears about a beautiful garden.
lines.zh: 有一天，玛丽听说了一个美丽的花园。

lines.t: It belonged to her uncle's wife.
After she died, the garden became a painful memory for him, so he locked it up.
lines.zh: 她死后，花园成了他痛苦的回忆，所以他把它锁了起来。

lines.t: No one has seen it for ten years.
One morning, Mary finds an old key.
lines.zh: 一天早上，玛丽找到了一把旧钥匙。

lines.t: When it unlocks a half-hidden door, she discovers the secret garden inside!
lines.zh: 当它打开一扇半隐蔽的门时，她发现了里面的秘密花园！

lines.t: Unfortunately, nobody has taken care of the plants, and therefore, much of it is in a bad state.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，没有人照料这些植物，因此，大部分都处于很糟的状态。

lines.t: Later, Mary tells her secret to a new friend, Dickon.
lines.zh: 后来，玛丽把她的秘密告诉了新朋友迪康。

lines.t: The young boy knows a lot about gardening, and they work together to make the garden beautiful again.
lines.zh: 这个男孩懂很多园艺知识，他们一起努力让花园重新变得美丽。

lines.t: One night, Mary hears someone crying again and discovers Colin, her cousin.
lines.zh: 一天晚上，玛丽又听到有人在哭，发现了她的表哥科林。

lines.t: He is unhappy and weak because he has lived alone in a hidden room since his mother's death.
lines.zh: 他不开心又虚弱，因为自从母亲去世后，他一直独自住在一个隐蔽的房间里。

lines.t: He has not walked for years because he thinks he has an illness.
lines.zh: 他好几年没走路了，因为他觉得自己有病。

lines.t: Mary and Dickon tell him stories about the garden and take him secretly to see it.
lines.zh: 玛丽和迪康给他讲花园的故事，还偷偷带他去看。

lines.t: Over time, Colin grows stronger.
lines.zh: 随着时间推移，科林变得越来越强壮。

lines.t: The fresh air and beautiful garden are good for him, and he proves that he is not ill when he gets to his feet for the first time in years!
lines.zh: 新鲜的空气和美丽的花园对他有好处，当他多年来第一次站起来时，他证明了自己没有病！

lines.t: The three friends spend time together in the garden and grow happier day by day.
lines.zh: 三个朋友在花园里一起度过时光，一天比一天快乐。

lines.t: In the end, Mary's uncle returns home.
lines.zh: 最后，玛丽的姑父回到了家。

lines.t: To his great surprise, he sees Colin walking and running, and he discovers that the secret garden has become as alive and beautiful as it ever was!
lines.zh: 让他非常惊讶的是，他看到科林在走、在跑，还发现秘密花园变得和从前一样生机勃勃、美丽动人！

lines.t: Interview 1
Excuse me,
are you a volunteer here?
Yes, I am.
How long have you been a volunteer with this football organization?
lines.zh: 你在这个足球组织做志愿者多久了？

lines.t: Oh, I've been a volunteer since last year.
lines.zh: 哦，我从去年开始做志愿者。

lines.t: What do you do?
Lots, really!
I help the players and give directions.
lines.zh: 我帮助球员，还给人指路。

lines.t: I clean up the stadium after matches too.
lines.zh: 比赛结束后我还打扫体育场。

lines.t: Interview 2
Sir, are you a volunteer here at the art museum?
lines.zh: 先生，您是这家美术馆的志愿者吗？

lines.t: That's right!
May I know what you do?
lines.zh: 我可以问问您做什么吗？

lines.t: I guide visitors through the museum and provide information about the paintings.
lines.zh: 我带参观者游览美术馆，介绍这些画。

lines.t: You see, I'm studying art history at university.
lines.zh: 你看，我在大学学艺术史。

lines.t: That's a good use of your skills!
lines.zh: 这样很好地发挥了你的专长！

lines.t: How long have you been a volunteer at the museum?
lines.zh: 你在美术馆做志愿者多久了？

lines.t: Well, I've only been a guide here for two weeks.
lines.zh: 嗯，我在这里当讲解员才两周。

lines.t: Interview 3
Let's talk to one of the volunteers with the beach clean-up organization.
lines.zh: 我们去和海滩清洁组织的一位志愿者聊聊吧。

lines.t: Excuse me, Miss.
How is the clean-up going?
lines.zh: 清洁工作进展得怎么样？

lines.t: It's going well!
I've picked up three bags of bottles and cans since our team arrived this morning.
lines.zh: 从今天早上我们团队到这里以来，我已经捡了三袋瓶子和罐子。

lines.t: You've worked hard!
Have you been a volunteer with the organization for long?
lines.zh: 你在这个组织做志愿者很久了吗？

lines.t: Yes, for about seven years.
Wow!
You must really care about the beach.
lines.zh: 你一定很爱护这片海滩。

lines.t: Yes, I think it's everyone's duty to look after it!
lines.zh: 是的，我认为保护它是每个人的责任！

Well, I clean the cages and feed the animals
And I look after the new dogs.
Some of them are in poor condition and need more care!
lines.zh: 有些狗状况很差，需要更多的照顾！

lines.t: And I collect donations for the shelter too.
lines.zh: 我还为收容所收集捐赠物。

lines.t: Goodness!

but my friend Rose has told me all about it.
lines.zh: 但我的朋友罗丝都跟我讲过了。

lines.zh: 我遛她，给她的碗添食物和水。

lines.zh: 因为她，我懂得了每只动物都很特别，都需要爱。

lines.zh: 我和老人们一起锻炼，帮助他们保持活力。

lines.t: Sometimes I play Chinese chess with them.
lines.zh: 有时我和他们下中国象棋。

lines.t: I've even taught some of them how to use a mobile phone.
lines.zh: 我甚至教过一些老人怎样用手机。

lines.t: That's great.
Do their families visit them often?
lines.zh: 他们的家人常来看他们吗？

lines.t: Some do, but not all.
lines.zh: 有些常来，但不是所有人。

lines.t: Many elderly people are very lonely.
That makes me sad.
We'll all be old one day too.
It's important to care for the elderly.
That's right!
You know, they actually have so many interesting life stories and experiences to share with us.
lines.zh: 你知道，他们其实有很多有趣的人生故事和经历可以和我们分享。

lines.t: Can I join your group of volunteers?
lines.zh: 我能加入你们的志愿者小组吗？

lines.t: I'd love to help.
Yes,
come along!
It's fun to volunteer together.
What kind of hook does the speaker use?
lines.zh: 演讲者用了什么样的开场方式？

lines.t: Which paragraph includes a call to action?
lines.zh: 哪一段包含了行动号召？

lines.t: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for inviting me to speak to you about Blue Sky Rescue today.
lines.zh: 女士们，先生们，谢谢你们今天邀请我来介绍蓝天救援队。

lines.t: Let me begin with my own story.
lines.zh: 让我从我自己的故事讲起。

lines.t: Back in 2008, I was hiking in the mountains with some friends when one of them fell and got a bad head injury.
lines.zh: 2008年，我和几个朋友在山里徒步时，其中一个人摔倒了，头部受了重伤。

lines.t: We had to find help quickly, so we called an emergency number.
lines.zh: 我们必须尽快找到帮助，于是拨打了急救电话。

lines.t: It was already dark, and we couldn't even see where we were.
lines.zh: 天已经黑了，我们甚至看不清自己在哪里。

lines.t: After some time, we heard dogs barking and the voices of the Blue Sky Rescue team. I nearly started crying.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，我们听到了狗叫声和蓝天救援队队员的声音。我差点哭了出来。

lines.t: We were so thankful that they found us!
lines.zh: 他们找到了我们，我们真是太感激了！

lines.t: I've never forgotten that day.
Since then, I've wanted to help others too.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我也想帮助别人。

lines.t: I signed up with Blue Sky Rescue in 2009, and I've been a volunteer ever since.
lines.zh: 我在2009年报名加入了蓝天救援队，从那以后一直是一名志愿者。

lines.t: We've been to schools and other communities to teach children and adults how to stay safe and prepare for the worst.
lines.zh: 我们去学校和其他社区，教孩子和大人如何保护自己、为最坏的情况做准备。

lines.t: We've also rescued people during emergencies.
lines.zh: 我们还在紧急情况下救援过人们。

lines.t: We've provided medical aid and searched for missing people after natural disasters, like the 2013 earthquake in Ya'an and the typhoon in the Philippines in the same year.
lines.zh: 我们在自然灾害后提供医疗援助、搜寻失踪人员，比如2013年的雅安地震和同年的菲律宾台风。

lines.t: In 2023, we even helped in places as far away as Türkiye!
lines.zh: 2023年，我们甚至在远至土耳其的地方提供了帮助！

lines.t: Working as a volunteer has taught me many practical life-saving skills.
lines.zh: 做志愿者教会了我许多实用的救生技能。

lines.t: It has also helped me understand the power of teamwork because it's the key to successful rescues.
lines.zh: 它还让我明白了团队合作的力量，因为这是救援成功的关键。

lines.t: Most of all, being a volunteer has taught me the value of every life.
lines.zh: 最重要的是，做志愿者让我懂得了每个生命的价值。

lines.t: The work is difficult.
It's voluntary, so we aren't paid.
lines.zh: 这是自愿的，所以我们没有报酬。

lines.t: We often go without food or sleep.
lines.zh: 我们常常顾不上吃饭睡觉。

lines.t: But our primary goal has always been to save as many people as we can.
lines.zh: 但我们的首要目标始终是尽可能多地救人。

lines.t: I'm just an ordinary person, but I'll rush into danger, just like everyone else in Blue Sky Rescue.
lines.zh: 我只是一个普通人，但我会冲向危险，就像蓝天救援队的其他人一样。

lines.t: To the people we've saved and their loved ones, I know we're their heroes. And that makes everything we do worth it.
lines.zh: 对于我们救过的人和他们的亲人，我知道我们是他们的英雄。这让我们做的一切都值得。

lines.t: We want to do even more, but we can't do it all alone.
lines.zh: 我们想做得更多，但我们不能单打独斗。

lines.t: Will you join us as a volunteer?
lines.zh: 你愿意作为志愿者加入我们吗？

lines.t: Together we can make a difference!
lines.zh: 我们一起就能带来改变！
